page.overview:
What is Dodogezan?

Much like their pre-evolved forms Bisharp and Pawniard, Kingambit has a helmet-like red and gray dome with a large blade protruding from it alongside massive crescent-shaped blades on its torso; however, they are much more massive. They have also grown a large "mustache" that is black in color with red edges. Its hands have also changed from chrome steel to a more gold appearance, fitting for its name. Unlike its pre-evolutions, Kingambit has noticeably grown a large amount of "hair" which it uses to navigate around.

Shiny Kingambit, much like their pre-evolved shiny forms, have the most of their red replaced with blue outside of their "mustache", which still retains the red edges. The torso changes from two layers of red to a layer of black and blue.

Kingambit are well-known for being extremely powerful, having evolved from the strongest Bisharp. They can be seen similarly to a ruling warlord in a local area, as all the Bisharp and Pawniard will answer a Kingambit's call. Orders given from a Kingambit are respected and carried out without question, with the Bisharp knowing insubordination is not allowed. Kingambit are also very battle-hungry and won't stop until its desires are fulfilled.

Despite this, Kingambit are not particularly skilled strategists, as they rely more on numbers and raw strength to defeat enemies.
